Details of improvements in Environmental and social impacts

Our R&D initiatives are centered on sustainable and eco-friendly technologies, including the use of recycled materials, increased reuse of process waste, and reduced freshwater consumption across our manufacturing operations. In addition, our cartons are manufactured using environmentally friendly, high-durability paper.

Over the years, we have undertaken several initiatives to strengthen our adoption of clean energy. Solar panels have been installed across our manufacturing facilities, while select locations source renewable electricity through Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and group captive arrangements. Furthermore, we have upgraded our infrastructure to enable the use of biomass as an alternative fuel, helping reduce reliance on conventional energy sources and supporting our sustainability objectives.
